description: Comprehensive offline test coverage for Module 3's analytical reliability and standalone pathway, plus the full-suite regression gate. Covers corporate-structure hardening, senior-management reasoning (especially credibility-vs-credit-direction), Validator 7 outcomes, the run_m3 end-to-end flow (asserting NO other BO specialist or downstream agent runs), structural reproducibility (hash-stable) and analytical-consistency/instability reporting, and the management-benchmark provenance. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002. Weakens NO existing expectation.
steps: Create tests/unit/test_bo_m3_senior_management.py covering, with controlled/scripted model responses and admitted-fixture evidence_texts (reuse the judge/scripted pattern from tests/unit/test_bo_m3_services.py and app/services/bo/m3_semantic_eval.py): supported; contradicted; neutral; mixed; insufficient-evidence (asserted DISTINCT from neutral); CORRECT financial values with UNSUPPORTED causal attribution (qualified/rejected, NOT accepted); numerical discrepancy; mismatched reporting period; unsupported execution claim (announcement/intention vs implemented action vs reported outcome); accurate disclosure of adverse performance where the statement is CREDIBLE but the observation is STILL credit-negative (assert disposition supported/qualified AND credit_direction negative AND credibility_vs_direction_note present - FEAT-001 item 9); unsupported/fabricated citation (downgraded). Assert direction/verification/availability stay in SEPARATE fields and no equal pos/neg count is forced.

In tests/unit/test_bo_m3_senior_management.py also cover Validator 7 outcomes: accepted; qualified; rejected; human-review-required; unsupported numerical claim; invalid evidence refs; a REJECTED material finding is EXCLUDED from m3_analysis consolidated_conclusion but retained in evidence_verification.rejected_items (FEAT-001 item 7); and completion-status consistency (A unavailable + B unavailable => incomplete; A unavailable + B assessed => partial; both present => complete) (FEAT-001 item 6).

Add a management-benchmark provenance test (in test_bo_m3_senior_management.py or a dedicated tests/unit/test_bo_m3_management_benchmark.py): assert each examples/bo_m3/management_benchmark/manifest.json source sha256 equals hashlib.sha256 of the referenced file, that each non-SCRIPTED case 'passage' is a verbatim substring of its cited htm file, that every case carries BOTH an independent credibility label and credit_direction label, that label_status is developer_authored_awaiting_external_review, and that at least one credible-adverse case and one unsupported-causal-attribution case are present. Mirror tests/unit/test_bo_m3_independent_evaluation.py.

Create tests/integration/test_bo_m3_standalone.py end-to-end: run app.services.bo.m3_standalone.run_m3 offline with a ScriptedBoBackend and the simplified HCA onboarding doc; assert the two deliverables are produced (A de-wrapped root with schema_version/artifact_type/visual_spec/companies and 14 nodes/13 links/5 guarantors; B references A by artifact id), the sidecar + all six demo files are written by m3_demo.write_m3_demo, and run_manifest records model_called + versions + source hashes. CRITICAL: assert that ONLY m3_corporate_management ran - query persisted AgenticAnalysisRun/audit rows and assert no other BO specialist agent id and no orchestrator/challenger/synthesis/downstream agent appears.

In tests/integration/test_bo_m3_standalone.py add: missing-input case (no corporate-structure document => A unavailable with exact NO_JSON_MESSAGE, B still assessed, completion partial, m3_corporate_structure.json NOT written); wrong-case association (fail closed, rejected); and a reproducibility test (identical simplified JSON => byte-identical exported m3_corporate_structure.json via canonical_json/content hash).

In tests/integration/test_bo_m3_standalone.py add an analytical-consistency test: run run_m3 twice with a ScriptedBoBackend returning the SAME proposal and assert the governed MATERIAL outputs (claims/evidence/verification/direction/materiality/contradictions/gaps/conclusion) are materially identical; then with a script returning a MATERIALLY different proposal on the second call assert the comparison REPORTS the instability rather than silently reconciling it. Do not demand word-for-word identical LLM text.

Run the FULL offline suite, record exact pass/skip/fail/error counts, and confirm the ONLY errors are the 12 known pre-existing tests/integration/test_bo_recorded_completion.py env errors (untracked output/bo/HCA_M3_REFINEMENT_LIVE_20261018_R5/...). Confirm zero NEW failures/errors and that no existing expectation was weakened (the FEAT-001 de-wrap test edits are contract corrections). Remove any temporary scratch files created during verification.
acceptance_criteria: tests/unit/test_bo_m3_senior_management.py passes and includes a test proving the credibility-vs-credit-direction distinction (credible adverse statement stays credit-negative) and a test proving a rejected material finding is excluded from the authoritative conclusion but kept in the audit trail.

tests/integration/test_bo_m3_standalone.py passes and asserts ONLY m3_corporate_management executed (no other BO specialist, no downstream agent), that all six demo files are written, that missing/wrong-case inputs fail closed, that the exported structure is byte-reproducible, and that material analytical instability across repeated runs is REPORTED.
The management-benchmark provenance test passes: manifest sha256 hashes resolve and non-SCRIPTED passages are verbatim substrings of the cited HCA 10-K files.
The FULL offline suite shows the new M3 tests passing, zero NEW failures/errors, and only the 12 known inherited env errors (vs baseline 1384 passed / 131 skipped / 12 errors).
verification: DEBUG=false .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q   (full offline suite; confirm only the 12 known test_bo_recorded_completion.py errors, zero new failures/errors)
findings:
THREE OFFLINE TEST FILES ADDED (no live/paid model calls; conftest blocks SEC + .env). All assertions written against the ACTUAL FEAT-001/FEAT-002 shapes.

1) tests/unit/test_bo_m3_senior_management.py (15 tests) drives app.services.bo.m3_validation.validate_m3_assessment directly with controlled admitted evidence_texts (mirrors test_bo_m3_v6_integration patterns). Covers: supported-on-faithful-evidence; contradicted numeric value -> rejected (rule m3.deterministic_entailment); mismatched reporting period -> rejected; numerical discrepancy with a valid citation id -> downgraded (citation!=entailment); neutral-assessed DISTINCT from insufficient_evidence (via assemble_m3_output section B status 'assessed' vs 'insufficient_evidence'); CORRECT-value-with-UNSUPPORTED-causal/outcome-attribution -> qualified/unverified not supported; intention-as-outcome execution claim -> not supported; unsupported/fabricated citation -> unverified (m3.evidence_integrity); CREDIBLE-ADVERSE: disposition supported/qualified AND credit_direction negative AND credibility_vs_direction_note present AND rule m3.credibility_vs_direction (FEAT-001 item 9); direction/verification/availability are SEPARATE fields; no equal pos/neg count forced; Validator-7 outcomes accepted/qualified/rejected/unverified in one proposal + consolidated_conclusion disposition 'human_review_required'; REJECTED material finding excluded from consolidated_conclusion.admitted_management_signal_ids but retained in evidence_verification (FEAT-001 item 7); invalid contradictory refs recorded+downgraded; completion-status consistency incomplete/partial/complete AND A-available+B-unavailable->incomplete (FEAT-001 item 6). NOTE: credit_direction is a VALIDATOR-added field on ManagementObservation; it must be supplied to validate_m3_assessment directly (the specialist BO_M3_JSON_SCHEMA management_assessment item is additionalProperties:false and does NOT accept credit_direction), so negative-direction cases are proven at the validator seam, not via the scripted specialist proposal.

2) tests/unit/test_bo_m3_management_benchmark.py (4 tests) mirrors test_bo_m3_independent_evaluation.py: each manifest.json source sha256 == hashlib.sha256 of the tracked HCA htm; label_status developer_authored_awaiting_external_review + review awaiting_external_review; 5-10 cases each with SEPARATE credibility.expected and credit_direction.label; each non-SCRIPTED passage is a verbatim substring of its cited htm after the manifest's HTML->text normalisation (strip tags, html.unescape, collapse whitespace) - all 8 HCA cases verified real-admitted; required credible-adverse (M3-03) and unsupported-causal-attribution (M3-05) cases present.

3) tests/integration/test_bo_m3_standalone.py (7 tests) runs app.services.bo.m3_standalone.run_m3 offline with the simplified HCA onboarding doc + a scripted single_pass response (FakeLLMBackend path; model_called False). Asserts: Deliverable A de-wrapped root (schema_version/artifact_type/visual_spec/companies, no refined_structure/artifact_kind) with 14 nodes / 13 ownership_links / 5 guarantors; B.corporate_structure_reference.artifact_id == sidecar artifact_id; completion 'complete'; m3_demo.write_m3_demo writes all SIX files; run_manifest records model_called False + cross_module_or_downstream_invoked False + validator_id validator_7 + roster/transform versions + source document_hash + an exact 'DEBUG=false ... run-m3 ...' reproduce_command; evaluation_scorecard actual_llm_semantic_accuracy 'not_measured' + completeness_caveat + explicit count denominators (numerator==denominator). CRITICAL: ONLY m3_corporate_management ran - exactly 1 AgenticAnalysisRun (analysis_mode agentic_bo_m3_standalone), exactly 1 EvidencePacketRow agent_id m3_corporate_management, AgentRunRow agent ids subset of {m3_corporate_management}, audit events contain bo_m3_standalone_executed and NONE of the forbidden downstream/cross-module event types. Fail-closed: missing doc -> A unavailable with verbatim NO_JSON_MESSAGE, B assessed, completion 'partial', m3_corporate_structure.json + provenance NOT written; wrong case association (admit under CASE_A, build under CASE_B) -> status 'rejected', svg None. Reproducibility: byte-identical canonical_json / content_hash export across independent fresh-session runs. Analytical consistency: repeated identical runs -> materially identical governed fingerprint; a materially different proposal (contradicted numeric claim) -> fingerprint DIFFERS (instability REPORTED, not reconciled), the claim governed to 'rejected', excluded from consolidated_conclusion but retained in evidence_verification.excluded_from_conclusion_ids. Each run_m3 uses a deterministic analysis_run_id derived from (case_id, snapshot_version, agent_id, run_identity); repeated runs with the SAME case in one session collide on the PK, so cross-run tests use independent in-memory sessions.

TEMP FILES: two scratch files (tests/integration/_scratch_m3.py, _scratch_val.py) created during development and REMOVED before commit.

VERIFICATION RESULTS: new files -> 26 passed (15 + 4 + 7). Targeted M3 suite (test_bo_m3_onboarding_transform.py + test_bo_m3_corporate_structure.py + test_bo_m3_v6_integration.py) -> 55 passed (no regression). FULL offline suite (DEBUG=false .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q) -> 1410 passed / 131 skipped / 0 failed / 12 errors. The 12 errors are EXACTLY the known pre-existing tests/integration/test_bo_recorded_completion.py env errors (missing untracked output/bo/HCA_M3_REFINEMENT_LIVE_20261018_R5/.../specialists_run.json; RecordedCompletionError) - inherited, NOT regressions. Zero NEW failures/errors; no existing expectation weakened (baseline 1384 passed + 26 new = 1410).
